outside_window.finding: Lock-up on the 74.0M registered merger shares first eases six months after the 2026-08-11 close: 50% transferable from about 2027-02-11, 75% at 9 months, all at 12 months. This is real supply, and it is 87% of shares outstanding. The plan of distribution allows underwritten offerings and block trades.

Possible overshoot on a misread headline: the S-3 blamed for the fall registers shares that are locked up until 2027-02. No named buyer, note or dated reading closes that gap by Monday's close, so it is not a finding.
Revolver draw period ends 2026-09-30 (moved from 08-30 by the Sixth Amendment), followed by a 12-month amortization. A further extension or its absence becomes visible after the window.
